issues.description: The template function state_preparation in the Lights Out exercise uses the parameter name 'switch_register', while the problem statement and other functions (oracle, diffusion, grover_circuit) consistently refer to this register as 'flip_register'. The solution implementation uses 'flip_register'. This inconsistent identifier in the template's function signature and docstring can confuse students about which register to use and how to map the problem description to the template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter 'switch_register' to 'flip_register' in the template's state_preparation signature and update its docstring to consistently refer to 'flip_register' (matching the oracle, diffusion, grover_circuit methods and the problem statement). This will remove the naming mismatch and reduce student confusion.
